settings.title: Settings
settings.tutorialDetail: Shows what to do on your turn, and why
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave the table in the middle of the game?

bid.no_honour: You hold no honour (skíz, XXI or pagát), so you may only pass.
bid.nothing_left: There is no bid left for you: pass.
bid.xxi_always: You hold the XXI: bid ({{bid}}) and try to win the talon, up to "one".
bid.xxi_stop_solo: Only solo is left. Even with the XXI that is too much: pass.
bid.skiz_strong_pass: You hold the skíz and {{count}} more tarokks. Your hand is strong as it is, so pass and do not show it.
bid.skiz_weak_bid: You hold the skíz but only {{count}} more tarokks: bid ({{bid}}) to improve your hand from the talon.
bid.limit_reached: The bidding is already at "{{bid}}". That is too high for this hand: pass.
bid.pagat_few_tarokks: Your only honour is the pagát and you have {{count}} tarokks. Open only with at least eight: pass.
bid.pagat_many_tarokks: Your only honour is the pagát, but you have {{count}} tarokks: bid ({{bid}}).

discard.suits: Put {{cards}} into the skart: empty your short suits that have no king, the dearest cards first.
discard.with_tarokks: Put {{cards}} into the skart. You have too few suit cards that may be discarded, so your lowest tarokks go as well.

call.xx: Call the {{rank}}: whoever holds it will be your partner.
call.lower: You hold the XX yourself, so call the {{rank}}, the highest tarokk below it that you do not have.

announce.pass: Nothing worth announcing with this hand: pass.
announce.four_kings: You are the caller's partner and hold {{count}} tarokks: announce four kings. It tells your partner that you are long in tarokks.
announce.double_game: You are the caller's partner with {{count}} tarokks above the XIII: announce double game.
announce.trull: You hold all three honours (skíz, XXI, pagát) and enough tarokks: announce trull.
announce.trull_partner: You are the declarer's partner and hold a great honour (skíz or XXI): announce trull.
announce.pagat_ultimo: You hold the pagát and {{count}} tarokks: announce pagát ultimo and keep the pagát for the last trick.
announce.several: This hand is good for {{count}} announcements, starting with {{announcement}}.
announce.double_after_signal: The four kings told you your partner is long in tarokks, and you hold {{count}} tarokks with a great honour: answer with double game.

lead.ulti_draw: You announced pagát ultimo: lead {{card}} to draw out the {{count}} tarokks the others may still hold.
lead.ulti_keep_pagat: You announced pagát ultimo: lead {{card}} and keep the pagát for the last trick.
lead.ulti_support: Your teammate announced pagát ultimo: lead {{card}} to help draw out the others' tarokks.
lead.keep_tarokk_for_ulti: The other side announced pagát ultimo. Keep {{kept_card}} to beat the pagát in the last trick: lead {{card}}.
lead.partner_last_tarokk: Assume your fellow defender holds the XXI. They play last in this trick, so lead a tarokk ({{card}}): they can bring the XXI home safely.
lead.suit_protect_xxi: Assume your fellow defender holds the XXI. They would not play last, so do not lead a tarokk: lead {{card}}.
lead.draw_tarokks: Your side has the upper hand in tarokks ({{count}} still out): lead {{card}} to draw them.
lead.long_suit: Lead {{card}}, the lowest card of your longest suit.
lead.low_tarokk: You have only tarokks left: lead your lowest, {{card}}.
lead.only_card: {{card}} is the only sensible card left to lead.
lead.skiz_suit: You hold the skíz and the XXI is still out. Do not lead a tarokk, the XXI could slip home under it: lead {{card}} and wait.
lead.skiz_low_tarokk: You hold the skíz and have no suit left: lead your lowest tarokk, {{card}}, and keep the skíz for the XXI.
lead.defender_suit: The skíz or the XXI is already played, so there is nothing left to protect: as a defender lead a suit, {{card}}.

follow.only_card: {{card}} is the only card you may play.
follow.catch_xxi: An opponent played the XXI: catch it with {{card}}!
follow.pagat_home: This trick is safely yours or your teammate's: bring the pagát home now.
follow.feed_teammate: Your teammate is winning this trick: give them your most valuable card, {{card}}.
follow.teammate_wins_low: Your teammate is winning this trick: do not waste a strong card, play {{card}}.
follow.win_cheap: This trick is worth taking: win it with {{card}}, the lowest card that wins.
follow.low: Not worth winning, or you cannot win it: play your cheapest card, {{card}}.
follow.skiz_duck_high: You are waiting with the skíz for the XXI, so stay out of the lead: get rid of a high tarokk that does not win, {{card}}.
follow.skiz_duck: You are waiting with the skíz for the XXI: do not take this trick, play {{card}}.
follow.skiz_forced: You cannot avoid this trick. Keep the skíz for the XXI: play {{card}}.
follow.hit_hard: An opponent still plays after you and a king is at stake: do not save tarokks, hit hard with {{card}}.
